title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate the diffusion of mask-wearing behavior in a population under social influence, information campaigns, policy mandates, and supply/price constraints.

interactions.name: SocialInfluence
interactions.description: Peers influence each other's mask usage through direct contacts in social networks and co-location. Influence increases usage probability based on neighbors' observed behavior.

interactions.name: ObservationalLearning
interactions.description: Agents update beliefs about mask efficacy and norms by observing aggregate usage within locations.

interactions.name: PolicyBroadcastAndCompliance
interactions.description: Authorities announce recommendations or mandates; agents become aware and adjust compliance according to propensity and perceived enforcement.

interactions.name: PolicyEnforcementEncounter
interactions.description: Random checks in locations result in fines or warnings for non-compliance, updating future compliance behavior.

interactions.name: InformationExposure
interactions.description: Information sources disseminate messages that affect risk perception and beliefs about mask efficacy.

interactions.name: PurchaseMasks
interactions.description: Agents attempt to buy masks subject to vendor stock, price, and rationing; affordability and perceived need determine purchase likelihood.

interactions.name: MovementAndContact
interactions.description: Agents move between locations (household, workplace/school, public) and engage in contacts that determine opportunities for social influence and potential policy enforcement.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Daily proportion of agents wearing masks across all contexts.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_50_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption reaches or exceeds 50%.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed daily adoption rate during the simulation.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of agents complying with active mandates when policy_level > 0.

metrics.name: context_specific_adoption
metrics.description: Adoption rates by location type (household, work/school, public).

metrics.name: purchase_conversion_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of attempted purchases that result in successful acquisitions given stock and price.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality
metrics.description: Inequality in mask adoption across socioeconomic groups or regions (e.g., Gini or variance).
